name: How do you remove smoke odor from a house?

mainEntity.name: How do you remove smoke odor from a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing smoke odor requires specialized techniques beyond surface cleaning. It involves thoroughly cleaning all surfaces, including walls, ceilings, and contents, to remove embedded soot and residue. Advanced methods like thermal fogging, ozone treatment, and hydroxyl generators are used to neutralize odor-causing particles at a molecular level. HVAC systems also need professional cleaning to prevent odors from recirculating. Proper ventilation and air purification are crucial steps in eliminating persistent smoke smells.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smoke odor removal involves specialized cleaning of surfaces, use of thermal fogging or ozone treatments, and HVAC system cleaning to neutralize embedded odors.
